name: uart_tx
title: Coal-UART — UART transmitter (8N1)
description: Build a UART transmitter, 8 data bits, no parity, 1 stop bit, with a baud divider. On send it transmits start(0), 8 data bits LSB-first, stop(1). Testbench prints uart_tx:PASS.
context: Parameter CLK_DIV (integer, default 4) sets bit period in clocks. Idle line tx=1. Asserting send (with busy=0) latches data and begins; busy=1 for the frame; tx=0 start, then d0..d7, then 1 stop; busy=0 when complete. Testbench CHECKs: idle tx=1; after send with data=8'h00, tx becomes 0 (start) and busy=1; after the frame completes busy=0 and tx=1. print uart_tx:PASS.

manifest.ports: input clk, input rst, input send, input [7:0] data, output reg tx, output reg busy
manifest.behavior: idle tx=1; on send busy=1 and tx=0 (start bit) then 8 LSB-first data bits then tx=1 stop and busy=0. print uart_tx:PASS if the start/stop behaviour is observed.
